acceptance: Получен проверяемый результат: Codex: Связать request IDs, disconnect и время ожидания. Указать изменённый символ/данные и наблюдаемый вывод; будущие шаги не считать выполненными.
note: Шаг <=15 минут. Оценка предполагает готовые входы; фиксировать конкретный разрыв и переразбить до продолжения. Модель плановая, исполнитель назначается Терой. progress_events.note: Добавляю request ID correlation, bounded timeout and disconnect behavior к отдельному Codex app-server process; проверю на fake/loopback transport.

Request correlation, timeout and disconnect are implemented and pass isolated stdio transport checks; no retry is performed. Code is rebased atop latest origin/main; public integration is pending core wiring.

changes.result: Extended crates/herder/src/adapters/codex/connection.rs in commit ace1a5d6 (rebased onto origin/main ca6b8c91). Each JSON-RPC call has a monotonic request ID; response correlation is exact, unrelated/late IDs are ignored, and notifications are retained. Timeout, partial write, malformed/read failure and disconnect carry the sent request ID and are marked outcome-unknown; no automatic retry exists. A pre-send dead process returns NotRunning. The same Cargo smoke harness passed 4/4: IDs/notification, late response after timeout followed by a new request, disconnect, malformed response. RED/GREEN compiler evidence: review-evidence/v053b-codex-connection/{red.log,green.log}; harness/outputs also in /home/roomhacker/.codex/worktrees/herder-codex-native/agent-herder/.tmp/v052b-codex-profile-20261107/. The V053 connection leaves are complete at transport layer; actual Herder crate export/integration still awaits Terra-owned lib.rs wiring.
